Prerequisite(s): —

MP Increase: Variable

Benefit: You can alter a spell with a range of touch, close, or medium to increase its range to a higher range category, using the following order: touch, close, medium, and long. Spells modified by this feat that require melee touch attacks instead require ranged touch attacks. Spells with a fixed range have their range doubled, for the cost of 1 MP. Spells with a range of personal do not benefit from this feat.
